Only the centreline ending is named by the spec; every other pattern is a placeholder to confirm on a real set, and the terminal words were tested on one set only (section 4.6). No existing word store maps terminal names to a system (grep of modeller/, viewer/, common/ 2026-11-08: viewer/import_worker.js maps names to a discipline only), so the terminal words live here.
